title: Homelab — morning view
description: One look in the morning: storage, downloads, requests, popular job, backups, security, certificates, domains, subscriptions, SMART, indexers. Docker/grafana/README.md 'Homelab — morning view'.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Critical + warning alerts firing now (digest-only alerts excluded).

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Age of the last successful nightly restic backup (Docker/_global backup). Orange > 26 h, red > 50 h.

panels.title: Malware (last scans)
panels.description: Infected files found by the last ClamAV run on fastpi, beefy and tower (alert MalwareFound).

panels.title: Secrets leaked (repos)
panels.description: gitleaks findings in the public GitHub repos (daily scan).

panels.title: beefy tiers used
panels.description: ssd = both SSDs (mover keeps ≤ 70 %, from 80 % downloads go to the HDD); hdd = archive (imports stop at 90 %).

panels.title: Mover last run
panels.description: Age of the last nightly SSD→HDD mover run (alert BeefyMoverNotRun > 50 h).

panels.title: Mover moved
panels.description: Bytes moved SSD→HDD by the last run (0 = nothing needed).

panels.title: HDD spin-ups / 24 h
panels.description: Start_Stop_Count rise of the cold HDD in the last 24 h (alert > 30).

panels.title: Power cycles / 24 h
panels.description: beefy power cycles seen by the HDD in the last 24 h (planned wakes included).

panels.title: Night queue waiting
panels.description: Night downloads paused, waiting for the low tariff (night-downloads.json).

panels.title: Active
panels.description: Requested titles downloading or importing now (request-state.json).

panels.title: Problems
panels.description: Requested titles whose download has a problem (Radarr/Sonarr queue warning).

panels.title: Last night imported
panels.description: Files imported by Radarr + Sonarr in the last 22:00-06:00 window.

panels.title: Last night size
panels.description: Size of what was imported last night.

panels.title: Seerr requests
panels.description: Seerr /request/count: pending = waiting for approval, processing = approved and on its way, completed = available.

panels.title: Request badges
panels.description: Seerr badge states (request-state.json): can wait = night download, unreleased, no release found yet, search running.

panels.title: Popular job last run
panels.description: Age of the last nightly Top-10/'Currently popular' run (jf_popular_last_run_timestamp_seconds, beefy Docker/Jellyfin popular job). n/a = the job exports no metrics yet.

panels.title: Last run ok
panels.description: jf_popular_last_run_success (1 ok, 0 failed).

panels.title: Items per list
panels.description: jf_popular_items{list}: titles in each list after the last run.

panels.title: Backup status
panels.description: Result of the last nightly backup run.

panels.title: Backup added
panels.description: New data added to the repository by the last backup.

panels.title: Fixable CVEs (images)
panels.description: Trivy: fixable CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerabilities in running images, per host (weekly scan; details on dashboard updates-security).

panels.title: TLS certificates (days left)
panels.description: Certificate Traefik really serves for every routed hostname (nightly TLS check 05:50). Alerts: ≤ 21 d warning, ≤ 7 d critical, not valid = warning.

panels.title: Domains
panels.description: RDAP, nightly. .ch publishes no end date: 'anniversary' = next registration anniversary (earliest the paid year ends), 'manual' = domains.toml. Alert ≤ 30 d.

panels.title: DDNS hostnames
panels.description: Free No-IP hostnames: confirm the 30-day mail, or No-IP deletes them (deadline not readable from outside; alert when a name stops resolving).

panels.title: Subscriptions (days left)
panels.description: Seerr indexer-bar/limits.toml (via subscription-alerts cache) + MAM VIP (abr-bar/limits.toml). Telegram warnings come from subscription-alerts.py (30/7/0 days). Lifetime ones are not listed.

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: smartctl -n standby every 30 min (fastpi; beefy while awake, pulled every 5 min). A parked disk is not woken: its last values stay, 'Asleep' = yes. Alerts: failing (critical), pending > 0, reallocated/uncorrectable/media errors rising, wear ≥ 80 %, temperature HDD 55 / SSD 65 / NVMe 75 °C.

panels.title: Limited indexers (used of limit)
panels.description: Indexers with a quota (Seerr bar on beefy, audiobook bar on fastpi), inside their window (rolling 24 h or calendar day).

panels.title: All indexers (used in window)
panels.description: Searches (API + RSS) and grabs per indexer inside its window.
